newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-ENQVIST GUIDES SWEDEN TO UNBEATABLE 3-1 LEAD.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ENQVIST GUIDES SWEDEN TO UNBEATABLE 3-1 LEAD.

text.p: Rosset 6-3 6-2 3-6 6-2 on Sunday to give Sweden an unbeatable
3-1 lead over Switzerland in their Davis Cup world group first
Enqvist, ranked 10th in the world, broke Rosset three times
in the opening two sets, before the Swiss fought back to take
Rosset lost his cool in the fourth set breaking his racquet
after slamming it into the court on the way to dropping the set
6-2 to hand the tie to Sweden.
Rosset said his marathon five-set victory over Magnus
Larsson on Friday coupled with Saturday's doubles loss, which
also went to five sets, had taken its toll.
